text: Smooth, wide footpath with steady lighting, only saw a couple of joggers.
Quiet residential stretch with decent overhead lighting, though overgrown bushes blocked a few lamps.
Very few pedestrians around, mostly fast-moving cars; the bike lane felt a bit exposed near the park.
Streetlights were bright near the campus gates, though it got much quieter past the main intersection.
Still plenty of foot traffic from people grabbing dinner, and the shopfronts lit up the footpath well.
